newsitem.title: USA: Disneyland Paris chief gets added responsibilities.
newsitem.headline: Disneyland Paris chief gets added responsibilities.

text.p: Walt Disney Co. Monday named Euro Disney S.A. Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Philippe Bourguignon to the additional position of executive vice president for Walt Disney Co. Europe S.A.

In a statement, Disney said Bourguignon's primary responsibility will continue to be the Disneyland Paris Resort. In addition, he will work with the European heads of each of Disney's major operating units to optimize Disney's businesses in Europe by coordinating all the company's activities there and helping define the Disney's overall strategy in the region.
Disney said business unit heads will continue to have responsibility and accountability for the operation of their individual business units.

Bourguignon, 48, was named chairman and chief executive of Euro Disney S.A. in April, 1993. He joined the Euro Disney project in 1988 as head of real estate development and was named president in September, 1992.
